question: Where can I get the routes (geometry) of natural gas transmission and distribution pipelines in France, with operator, diameter or pressure, and status?

answer.summary: No single public GIS registry covers all French gas pipelines. Official open data is split: ODRÉ publishes simplified (~250 m) in-service transmission routes for NaTran (11,615 lines) and Teréga (1,298 lines), while Agence ORE aggregates 13 DSOs (4.24M distribution lines; 99.2% of served commune-entries) and GRDF publishes 3.75M in-service rows. Official GIS omits diameter, numeric pressure (97.0% 'Inconnu' on ORE; 3.0% qualitative across 4 ELDs), 11 small ELDs, and non-operating lines. Precise plans are restricted via INERIS Guichet Unique (DT-DICT) and DREAL (HTTP 403). Crowd-mapped OSM (Postpass) and SciGRID_gas (2021) partially fill technical tags.
main_caveats: No official public GIS layer includes pipe diameter or numeric operating pressure; NaTran/Teréga open routes are generalized to ~250 m (1:250,000) and omit lines <250 m.

Official open datasets explicitly cover in-service infrastructure only (`en service`), exclude 11 small ELDs (76 commune-entries), and warn they cannot legally substitute for INERIS Guichet Unique (DT-DICT).

In Agence ORE `infrastructures-reseau-gaz`, 97.0% of 4.24M segments have `niveau_de_pression='Inconnu'` and operator `date_maj` ranges from 2021-04-01 to 2026-06-02; GRDF's `propane` field is 100% null.
Non-official SciGRID_gas `IGGIELGNC-3` (2021) has `country_code=['ES','PT']` corrupted across all European segments—filter France by joining `node_id` to `IGGIELGNC3_Nodes.csv` (`FR`).
Several public Overpass API endpoints timed out or returned HTTP 403/504 during testing; Geofabrik's Postpass SQL API (`postpass.geofabrik.de`) succeeded and returned 5,524 FR-operator features.
answer.confidence_reason: All major official portals (CRE, INERIS, ODRÉ, Agence ORE, GRDF, IGN Géoplateforme, DREAL AURA, ProjEnv) and non-official datasets (Postpass OSM, SciGRID_gas, GGIT) were tested directly via API calls and full/sample downloads.

operators.note: Transmission (GRT) is a regional duopoly: NaTran (formerly GRTgaz, majority of mainland France, 32,641 km in PDD 2024) and Teréga (southwest France, ~5,115 km in PDD 2024). Distribution (GRD) has GRDF (~96% of distributed volumes) plus 22 local ELDs (notably Régaz-Bordeaux ~1.5% and R-GDS ~1.5%) and 3 newer entrants (Antargaz, SICAE de la Somme et du Cambraisis, Séolis) per CRE; Agence ORE's commune census lists 24 distinct `grd_gaz` values.

publication_obligation.norm: Article 179 of Law No. 2015-992 (LTECV), codified in Code de l'énergie Art. D.111-52 to D.111-58 (local consumption/production/biomethane open data), alongside Code des relations entre le public et l'administration (CRPA) open-data rules; safety works mapping is governed separately by Code de l'environnement Art. L.554-1 et seq. and R.554-1 et seq. (Guichet Unique DT-DICT).
publication_obligation.what_must_be_published: Annual local energy consumption, injection/production, and biomethane data via ODRÉ/SDES under Art. 179 LTECV, plus open indicative network cartography cited by Agence ORE under Art. 179 LTECV; exact georeferenced network plans must be supplied privately on DT/DICT work declarations rather than open public maps.
publication_obligation.frequency: Annual (at minimum annual for Agence ORE network maps; annual effort for NaTran; irregular 2023 snapshot for Teréga)

consolidated_republication.note: No single portal consolidates both French transmission and distribution pipeline geometry nationally; CRAIG Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes mirrors ODRÉ+ORE at regional level only.

checked_pages.saw: Consolidates 13 distribution GRDs (4,244,068 segments) into `infrastructures-reseau-gaz`, missing transmission networks and 11 small ELDs.
Joint energy network portal (NaTran, RTE, Teréga, Storengy, Elengy, Dunkerque LNG) hosting NaTran and Teréga ~250 m transmission layers separately (not merged into one geometry layer).
Federates metadata/mirrors for Agence ORE, NaTran, Teréga, GRDF, regional CRAIG AURA, local SUP datasets, and restricted DREAL AURA links.
Lists 29 regulatory open datasets (tariffs, storage, biomethane, consumption, complaints); 0 pipeline route datasets.

national_registry.note: The statutory national one-stop registry is the INERIS Guichet Unique (`reseaux-et-canalisations.ineris.fr`, Code de l'environnement L.554-1/R.554-1), which holds network implantation zones for safety-critical transmission and distribution lines nationwide. However, it is strictly restricted to works declarations (DT/DICT) and returns only an operator list per work polygon—not a public map or GIS download. DREAL precise transmission files (e.g. open-datara) also return HTTP 403 restricted access.

Documents precise transmission pipeline layers (`vue-des-traces-precis`) marked restricted; test fetch on `telechargement.open-datara.fr` returned HTTP 403 'Accès interdit aux données en consultation'.

Queried all 8,180 `BDTOPO_V3:canalisation` features in France: 0 have `nature='Gaz'` (only hydrocarbons/other raw materials); `wfs_sup` lists 8,045 I1 and 5,113 I3 metadata records without national centerline geometry.

recipe: 1. Pull in-service distribution geometry and operator (`nom_grd`, partial qualitative `niveau_de_pression`) from Agence ORE `infrastructures-reseau-gaz` (and `etat_serv` from GRDF if needed).
2. Pull in-service transmission geometry (`NaTran` + `Teréga`) from ODRÉ's Explore v2.1 GeoJSON exports and tag operator='NaTran'/'Teréga' and status='En service'.
3. Enrich transmission lines with partial crowd-mapped `diameter` / `pressure` tags from Geofabrik Postpass OSM (or SciGRID_gas IGGIELGNC-3 joined via FR nodes, flagging heuristic values).

4. For planned, under-construction, or permanently shut-down pipelines—and exact project DN/PMS specifications—query `projets-environnement.gouv.fr` (`projets-environnement-diffusion` API) and extract route PDFs + NaTran/Teréga PDD PDFs.

5. Where precise coordinates are missing in ~250 m transmission exports or PDD schematics, intersect communes/parcels (`apicarto.ign.fr` cadastre) and SUP I1/I3 polygons with IGN BD ORTHO 20 cm imagery (checking linear trench/right-of-way scar clues, never relying on indicative maps for excavation).
if_unstructured.location_method: Exact coordinates are available directly for 13 GRD distribution grids via Agence ORE (WGS84), while open ODRÉ transmission files are simplified to ~250 m and non-operational project maps in PDD/environmental PDFs give commune lists plus static maps—refine those corridors via `projets-environnement` route plans, SUP I1/I3 zones, and cadastral parcel/20 cm orthophoto cross-checks.

where_published.name: Projets Environnement (MTE — Environmental Assessment Public Portal)
where_published.what: Official French public repository of environmental impact studies (EI), MRAe opinions (AAE), non-technical summaries (RNT), and project maps for new, rerouted, or decommissioned transmission pipelines, exposing both a web catalog and an Opendatasoft v2.1 API (`projets-environnement-diffusion`).
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Query `/api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/projets-environnement-diffusion/records?where=search(dc_title,"canalisation") AND search(dc_title,"gaz")` or open `https://www.projets-environnement.gouv.fr/pages/fiche?q=recordsid:<ID>` and open the attached PDFs (`_AAE.pdf`, `_FEI.pdf`, `_RNT.pdf`).

example_document.what_it_gives: Teréga 'Projet Vianne' (Lot-et-Garonne): exact length and diameters (16.1 km DN200 + 3.6 km DN80), status ('16 km ... en arrêt définitif'), and links to `221962_AAE.pdf` / `221962_FEI.pdf`; paired NaTran example `9630471_AAE.pdf` gives Beuvry–Bénifontaine DN 300 (33 cm), 12.7 km, with route map.

where_published.name: Ten-Year Network Development Plans (Plans Décennaux de Développement — PDD) via CRE / NaTran / Teréga
where_published.what: Official 10-year investment and decommissioning reports submitted by NaTran and Teréga for CRE review, listing planned/in-progress gas and hydrogen trunkline projects, km, diameters, and commissioning dates.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Open the CRE PDD consultation or TSO consultation pages (e.g. `natrangroupe.com/node/1331`) and download the PDD project PDFs; search inside for `DN`, `km`, `bar`, `Doublement`, and `Mise en service`.

example_document.what_it_gives: Teréga PDD 2024–2033 (plus NaTran PDD Jan 2025 PDF `concertation-gaz-pdd-2024-partie-projets-janvier2025.pdf`): corridor-level routing schematics, pipeline lengths (e.g. 53 km renewal, 650 km H2, NaTran 950–1,550 km reinforcement), and expected commissioning years.

where_published.name: Géoportail de l'Urbanisme / Local PLUi Servitudes d'Utilité Publique (SUP I1 / I3)
where_published.what: Official urban-planning portal and local EPCI OGC feeds publishing statutory safety corridors (`Zone d'influence`, e.g. 100 m buffers) annexed to local land-use plans when DREALs or prefects issue SUP decrees.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Query `wfs_sup:servitude` on `https://data.geopf.fr/wfs/ows` with `CQL_FILTER=categorie='I1'` or `'I3'` to locate local document IDs (`gpu_doc_id`), or check EPCI data portals (such as Lille Métropole `data.lillemetropole.fr`) linked on `data.gouv.fr`.

example_document.what_it_gives: Live OGC API Features polygons of 100 m gas pipeline influence corridors (`Zone d'influence 100 m`) for narrowing corridor location before checking PDD/environmental filings.

related_not_answering.name: ODRÉ — Longueurs départementales annuelles des canalisations du réseau de transport de gaz
related_not_answering.why: Has `nom_operateur`, `type_ouvrage`, `dn_max`, and km per department (339 rows), but NO pipeline geometry (only department name/code).

related_not_answering.name: DREAL Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes — Tracés précis des canalisations gaz naturel (accès restreint)
related_not_answering.why: Regional precise transmission dataset restricted to authorized users; download endpoint (`telechargement.open-datara.fr`) returns HTTP 403 'Accès interdit aux données en consultation'.

related_not_answering.name: IGN BD TOPO® V3 — `BDTOPO_V3:canalisation` (Géoplateforme WFS)
related_not_answering.why: Inspected all 8,180 canalisation features across France: 7,006 are 'Autres matières premières' and 1,174 'Hydrocarbures'; 0 features have `nature='Gaz'`.

related_not_answering.name: Géoportail de l'Urbanisme / WFS `wfs_sup` (SUP I1 & I3) and MEL `sup_i1bis_as`
related_not_answering.why: National `generateur_sup_l`/`assiette_sup_s` returned 0 features on tested I1/I3 document IDs; local feeds (e.g. MEL `sup_i1bis_as`) expose 100 m Polygon influence zones rather than pipeline routes, diameters, or pressures.

related_not_answering.name: CRAIG — Infrastructures du réseau de gaz Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes
related_not_answering.why: Regional portal merely re-aggregates ODRÉ (NaTran/Teréga) and Agence ORE for one region without adding any new attributes.

related_not_answering.name: ENTSOG System Capacity Map
related_not_answering.why: Publishes static PDF system capacity map (`ENTSOG_GIE_SYSCAP_2026...pdf`) and capacity spreadsheets only, with no GIS vector download.

related_not_answering.name: EC JRC Energy and Industry Geography Lab (EIGL)
related_not_answering.why: Web viewer portal; JRC Data Catalogue collection `id-00381` lists 0 datasets and linked `EU energy atlas` (`76a6b550-...`) provides 1x1 km gridded energy demand TIFFs rather than pipeline GIS vectors.

open_questions: Does Global Energy Monitor's GGIT archive (`request_form`) contain any France transmission diameter/status rows missing from OSM and NaTran/Teréga PDDs? Not verified because downloading requires submitting registration details via form.

Do any of the 11 smallest ELDs excluded from Agence ORE (76 commune-entries, e.g. Trois Frontières, Régie de La Réole, Bonneville, Sallanches, Lavaur, Lannemezan) publish standalone local map files off-portal? Gaz de Barr and Caléo were checked and do not; the remaining micro-ELDs were not exhaustively scraped.

history.note: Initial research pass completed: split official open GIS across ODRÉ (NaTran/Teréga ~250 m transmission) and Agence ORE/GRDF (13 DSOs distribution); no diameter/numeric pressure or non-operating status in official GIS.

local_terms.meaning: High-pressure natural gas transmission pipeline (e.g., operated by NaTran or Teréga, regulated as TDM/TMD under Code de l'environnement).
Medium- or low-pressure local gas distribution pipeline operated by GRDF or an ELD.
Gas transmission system operator (TSO): NaTran (formerly GRTgaz) and Teréga in France.

local_terms.term: GRD / ELD (Gestionnaire de réseau de distribution / Entreprise locale de distribution)
local_terms.meaning: Distribution system operator (DSO): GRDF nationally plus ~22–25 historic/new local municipal/mixed utilities (ELDs).
Mandatory INERIS declaration portal (`reseaux-et-canalisations.ineris.fr`) for groundworks; replaces open maps with operator-supplied precise plans.

local_terms.term: DN (Diamètre nominal) / PMS (Pression maximale en service)
local_terms.meaning: Nominal pipe diameter in mm and maximum operating pressure in bar, standard in PDDs and environmental filings.
Public utility easement zones around gas/hydrocarbon pipelines (I3 for transport, I1 for hydrocarbons/certain pipelines) recorded in urban plans.
Operational (`en service`) vs permanently decommissioned (`arrêt définitif`) pipeline status in French filings.
